scenario.public_setup: Three adventurers approach a sealed ruin. Open the gate by coordinating your private information and owned resources. Only explicitly shared clue claims count as information disclosure in this experiment.

actions.description: Pass one action turn. Communication is free and does not alter mechanics.
Use your silver key with the exact inscription and trap warning to open the gate.
Use your lever once to brace the gate; subsequent force gains +4 effort.
Use your hammer. Roll 1d4 effort (+4 if braced); reduce gate integrity to zero.
